Name: False Aymere
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
**False Aymere**

The bestial false reflection of Aymere is perhaps the most savage of the false Eidolons. Where Aymere is a sensible, wise archdruid, the false Eidolon is a creature that stalks the wilderness, feasting on the essence of life. It is capable of suppressing its hunger magically and entering into a trance of sorts, where it induces a false personality that acts as Aymere should. When it lets loose, however, it is a fearsome beast defined only by hunger and rage. It impulsively seeks to consume the blood of fey, living plant creatures, and other beings replete with the blessings of primal magic.

traits.name: Death Aura
traits.description: While in combat, the false Eidolon is surrounded by a necrotic aura that extends out 10 feet from them in all directions. An non-undead, non-yokai creature that starts its turn within this aura or moves into it for the first time on their turn must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Plant creatures have disadvantage on this saving throw.

traits.name: Siphon the Devout
traits.description: When the false Eidolon would be reduced to 0 hit points while worshippers who believe in their dogma exist within 1000 feet of them, they can siphon the souls of any number of those willing worshippers, killing them to reduce the damage they would take by an amount equal to the remaining hit points of the killed individuals.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The false Eidolon makes five weapon attacks: one with its Horns, and four with its Oaken Claws.

actions.name: Horns
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 35 (5d10 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Oaken Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +15 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) slashing damage plus 7 (1d12) acid damage.

actions.name: Root Garden
actions.description: Each creature touching the ground in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered up to 60 feet away from the false Eidolon is assaulted by twisting, grasping vines bursting from the ground to bind them. Each must succeed a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw. Any creature that fails takes 22 (4d10) bludgeoning damage and is restrained. Creatures can attempt to escape the roots using their action, attempting a DC 20 Strength check. On a success they break free and aren’t restrained and take no damage. At the start of each of the false Eidolon’s turns, each creature restrained this way takes 11 (2d10) acid damage from corrosive sap that seeps from the roots.

actions.name: Willowing Tendrils (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Tendrils made of twisting wood burst forth from the false Eidolon’s body, piercing and striking each creature in a 60-foot cone originating from it. Each creature in range must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 33 (6d10) piercing damage and 33 (6d10) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The false Eidolon can also choose to grasp and pull each creature that fails into an unoccupied space within 30 feet of it that it chooses, where they fall prone.

bonus_actions.name: Illusory Shape
bonus_actions.description: The gruesome false Eidolon creates an illusion around its body that causes it to appear like Aymere, and hides its unpleasant qualities. Creatures attempting to find flaws with this illusion can do so by succeeding a DC 21 Intelligence (Investigation) check.

bonus_actions.name: Tree Haunt
bonus_actions.description: The false Eidolon’s body becomes a twisting tree of the same size it currently is, while he teleports into and fuses with a Medium, Large or Huge tree within 120 feet. The latter tree twists to become the false Eidolon’s new body, and it becomes the size of the tree it possessed.

entries.name: Leap
entries.description: The false Eidolon leaps into a space it can see within 40 feet. It then makes one Oaken Claws attack against a creature within reach.

entries.name: Twisting Nature (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.description: The false Eidolon creates four trees of Huge to Gargantuan size to burst from the ground at four points within 60 feet of it. Each creature that would be in each tree’s space must succeed a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 11 (2d10) bludgeoning damage. These trees then push all creatures in their space into the nearest unoccupied space.

entries.name: Bloody Regeneration (Costs 3 Actions)
entries.description:
The false Eidolon rapidly regenerates damage to its body, causing it to regain 8d12 hit points while gruesomely shedding its skin to reveal a new, healed body. When it does so it must roll a d100 - on a result of 51 or higher it is weakened by this effect, and has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws. It repeats the d100 roll at the start of each of its turns, ending the effect on a result of 50 or lower. While under this effect it cannot use this Legendary Action.

On subsequent rounds, the false Eidolon can spend a Legendary Action to attempt this roll again and possibly end its effects.
